description:
Don't require ANTHROPIC_API_KEY when Claude Code is already logged in or the user has an OAuth token available. Port pi-mono's OAuth machinery (anthropic.ts auth-path branch + utils/oauth/anthropic.ts + cli.ts) and adjacent tests (anthropic-tool-name-normalization.test.ts, anthropic-oauth.test.ts).

Phase 2 concern, landing after octo-42f closed. Anthropic provider will be the first consumer; the pattern generalizes to other providers later.

See docs/port-map/anthropic.md §1.2 — OAuth was explicitly deferred from Phase 1.
title: [EPIC] Claude Code OAuth support for octo_pi_ai
